statement.en: Held de se, self-concern is the same from every standpoint exactly where the centers lie within one another's closures; on the base, a consumer needs a feeder exactly where the others could not together give what a step demands, and drawing past a hierarchy fed from above needs giving into its top.
statement.zh: 从己地持有，自我关切恰在诸中心彼此位于对方闭包之内处对每个立场都相同；在基底上，消耗者恰在其余者合起来给不出某步需求之处需要某供给者的给予，而汲取超出只从上方供给的层级，需要向其顶层的给予。

laws.en: Held de se, the presupposition about the own closure along a relation is standpoint-invariant, and the de se and de dicto readings give significance alike, exactly where every center lies within every center's closure; the centers then have one closure, and the whole need not lie within it.
laws.zh: 从己地持有，关于沿一个关系的自身闭包的预设对立场不变，且从己与从言两种读法给出相同的意义，恰在每个中心都位于每个中心的闭包之内处；诸中心于是有同一个闭包，而整体不必在其中。

laws.en: Centers that at one step take part, require one condition and give to it lie within one another's feeding closures; centers that depend on one condition and exchange with it lie within one another's influence closures. So self-concern held de se along feeding, or along being affected, is one from all of them.
laws.zh: 在某一步都在场、都需要同一个条件并都给予它的诸中心，彼此位于对方的供养闭包之内；都依存于同一个条件并与之交换的诸中心，彼此位于对方的影响闭包之内。所以沿供养或沿受影响从己持有的自我关切，从它们每一个看都相同。

laws.en: Over possible courses, a formation needs another where the other continues on every course on which it does. Need is its own closure, so drawn along need a standpoint's presupposition reaches exactly what its continuation needs.
laws.zh: 在可能的进程上，一个构成需要另一个，指在它延续的每条进程上另一个都延续。“所需”即其自身的闭包，所以沿“所需”来画，立场的预设恰达到其延续所需者。

laws.en: Where a formation needs some member of a class and each member can carry its continuation alone, it needs a member exactly where that member is the only one, and the presupposition drawn along need reaches it exactly then. Witness: with two copies the user needs some copy and neither of the two.
laws.zh: 一个构成需要某类中的某个成员、且每个成员都能单独承载其延续时，它恰在某成员是唯一者时需要该成员，沿“所需”来画的预设也恰在此时达到它。见证：有两个副本时，使用者需要某个副本，而两个都不需要。

laws.en: Over possible courses of any type, a formation's continuation needs another's part where that part is taken on every possible course on which the first continues, the two read off the course. Where it needs the part of some member of a class and each member can take it alone, it needs a member's part exactly where that member is the only one; one reading for both is the marking case.
laws.zh: 在任何类型的可能进程上，一个构成的延续需要另一个的份，指在前者延续的每条可能进程上后者都尽其份，二者从进程读出。它需要某类中某成员的份、且每个成员都能单独尽之时，恰在某成员是唯一者时需要该成员的份；两者用同一读法，是标记的情形。

laws.en: On the base, over balanced flows with their webs in which only active formations give and only a class gives to a family, a formation drawing past the family's stock across a stretch has some member of the class giving to the family within it, and, where each member can feed alone, needs a given feeder's giving exactly where that feeder is the only member. Witness: two flows of one condition, each fed by one copy.
laws.zh: 在基底上，就平衡、只有活跃构成给予、且只有某一类给予某条件族的流及其依存网而言，在一段步上汲取超出该族存量的构成，在这段之内有该类的某成员给予该族；它恰在某供给者是唯一者时需要该供给者的给予。见证：同一条件的两个流，各由一个副本供给。（此“唯一者”之律以每个成员都能单独供给该族为前提。）

laws.en: With the web fixed, the possible flows balance on the family within the stretch, only active formations give and only a class gives to the family; over them a formation drawing past the stock needs some member's giving. A step calls for giving where some condition rises or none falls, and there a drawing consumer forces giving.
laws.zh: 固定依存网，可能的流在一段步之内对该族平衡、只有活跃构成给予、只有某一类给予该族；在其上，汲取超出存量的构成需要某成员的给予。某条件上升或没有条件下降的步需要给予，在那里汲取的消耗者迫使给予。

laws.en: Read off the web, every member active at every step calling for giving can feed the family alone, by the flow drawn across the stretch with that member giving; so the copies law holds over the web with nothing supplied. On Feeders' web, where every formation is active, neither copy is needed.
laws.zh: 从依存网读出，在每个需要给予的步上都活跃的成员都能单独供给该族，由以该成员给予画过这段步的流可见；所以副本之律在依存网上成立，无需另设。在 Feeders 的依存网上每个构成都活跃，两个副本都不被需要。

laws.en: With activity and identity decided and the class listed, a consumer drawing past the stock needs a member's giving exactly where, at some step calling for giving, no member other than it is active (vacuously so where none is). Witness FeedersInTurn: two copies active in turn, both needed.
laws.zh: 活动与同一可判定、类为有限列表时，汲取超出存量的消耗者恰在某个需要给予的步上没有其他成员活跃时需要它的给予。见证 FeedersInTurn：两个轮流活跃的副本，两者都被需要。

laws.en: A step's demand is what the family's conditions rise, and one more where none falls; it is positive exactly where the step calls for giving. Every balanced flow in which a consumer takes from the family gives it at least the demand, and the least flow, with one giver, gives exactly the demand.
laws.zh: 某步的需求是该族诸条件的上升量，在无一下降处再加一；它恰在该步需要给予处为正。消耗者从该族取用的每个平衡的流至少给予该族这一需求，而只有一个给予者的最小流恰好给予这一需求。

laws.en: With capacities supplied with the web, and each formation taking part once a step, a member can feed the family alone exactly where, at every step calling for giving, it is active and its capacity covers the demand; where every member can, the copies law holds.
laws.zh: 以随依存网给定的容量、每个构成每步只参与一次，某成员恰在每个需要给予之步上活跃且其容量覆盖需求时能单独供给该族；每个成员都能时，副本之律成立。

laws.en: A feeder is needed wherever, at some step of the stretch, the capacities of the other members active there total less than the demand. Witness Capacities: with one unit and two against a demand of two the user needs the second copy and not the first; with one unit each, neither can feed alone, both giving feed the condition, and the user needs both.
laws.zh: 凡在这段步中的某步上其余活跃成员的容量合计少于需求之处，供给者都被需要。见证 Capacities：以一个单位与两个单位对两个单位的需求，使用者需要第二个副本而不需要第一个；各一个单位时，两者都不能单独供给，两者一起给予能供给该条件，使用者两者都需要。

laws.en: Where the other active members can together give each step's demand, pairing in order the units each condition is to be given with the units they can give divides the giving within their capacities: the shared flow balances on the family, gives each formation at most what it can give apart from the feeder in question, and has the consumer drawing past the stock with that feeder never giving.
laws.zh: 其余活跃成员合起来能给出每步的需求时，按顺序把每个条件应得的单位与它们能给的单位配对，就在容量之内分担了给予：分担之流对该族平衡，每个构成所给不超过它除所论供给者外能给的，消耗者汲取超出存量而该供给者从不给予。

laws.en: With activity and identity decided and the family and the class listed without repetition, a consumer drawing past the stock needs a feeder's giving exactly where, at some step of the stretch, what the other active members can give together falls short of the demand. Witness SharedCopies: three copies of one unit each against a demand of two; no copy can feed alone, the class is needed, and no copy.
laws.zh: 活动与同一可判定、该族与该类都列出而无重复时，汲取超出存量的消耗者恰在这段步的某步上其余活跃成员合起来能给的少于需求之处需要某供给者的给予。见证 SharedCopies：三个各一单位的副本对两个单位的需求；没有副本能单独供给，该类被需要，而没有哪个副本被需要。

laws.en: What the formations taking part give a family, each passing on at most what it takes from a supply, is at most what is taken from the supply; the supply after the step, with what it passed on, holds at most what it held and was given, so a supply that nothing feeds passes on at most what it loses, and an exhausted one nothing.
laws.zh: 参与的构成给予某族者，若各自所给不超过它从某供给处所取，则至多是从供给处所取之量；该步之后供给处连同所传出者，至多是它原有的与所得的，所以无所供给的供给处至多传出它失去的，耗尽者什么也传不出。

laws.en: Where each feeder gives the family at most what it takes from its own store, which nothing feeds, its capacity at a step is the store's fall, read off the web; with the stores its own, outside the family and not rising in the stretch, a consumer needs a feeder's giving exactly where the other active feeders' stores together fall short of the demand. Witness OwnStores: a store running out leaves its feeder no copy.
laws.zh: 每个供给者给该族的不超过它从自己的、无所供给的库存所取时，它某步的容量就是库存的下降量，从依存网读出；库存各属其主、在该族之外且在这段步内不上升时，消耗者恰在其余活跃供给者的库存下降量合计少于需求之处需要某供给者的给予。见证 OwnStores：库存耗尽的供给者不再是副本。

laws.en: Over a hierarchy of families, each given only what is passed on from the one above, what is drawn from the bottom across a stretch is at most what the whole hierarchy held and what was given to its top; so drawing past what the whole hierarchy holds needs giving into its top. Witness TwoTiers: a user needs the giving of its feeder's source.
laws.zh: 在一个层级的诸族之上，若每族只得到从其上一族传来者，那么一段步内从底层取走的，至多是整个层级原有的与其顶层所得的；所以汲取超出整个层级所持有者需要向其顶层的给予。见证 TwoTiers：使用者需要其供给者之来源的给予。

laws.en: A feeder's shortfall is what a step demands beyond what the other active members can give. In every possible flow in which the consumer draws past the stock the feeder gives at least the sum of its shortfalls, and wherever a flow is possible some has it give exactly that: its degree of need. Need is a positive degree. Witness Capacities: the second copy needed in degree one, the first in degree zero.
laws.zh: 供给者某步的缺额，是该步需求超出其余活跃成员合起来能给者。在消耗者汲取超出存量的每个可能的流中，供给者所给至少是其缺额之和；凡有可能的流，某个流使它恰好给出这么多：这是它被需要的程度。“所需”就是程度为正。见证 Capacities：第二个副本被需要的程度为一，第一个为零。

laws.en: Some flow read off a web with capacities lets the consumer draw past the stock exactly where the class can give each step's demand; elsewhere every need holds vacuously, and wherever a flow is possible the degree of need is attained. Drawing without end needs giving without end: after every step some member gives within the next stock-plus-one steps. Witness FeedersInTurn.possible.
laws.zh: 某个从依存网读出的有容量的流使消耗者汲取超出存量，恰在该类能给出每步需求之处；别处一切“所需”都是空真的，凡有可能的流，被需要的程度都可达成。无尽的汲取需要无尽的给予：每一步之后，在随后存量加一步之内有某成员给予。见证 FeedersInTurn.possible。

laws.en: With capacities read off the feeders' own stores, under the store law's premises, every flow from the stores in which the consumer draws past the stock has each member give at least the sum of its shortfalls under the stores' falls, and where a member can give each, some such flow has it give exactly that. Witness OwnStores: the first feeder needed in degree two, the second in degree zero.
laws.zh: 以从供给者自身库存读出的容量，在库存之律的前提下，消耗者汲取超出存量的每个库存之流都使每个成员至少给出其在库存下降量下的缺额之和；某成员能给出每个缺额时，某个这样的流使它恰好给出这么多。见证 OwnStores：第一个供给者被需要的程度为二，第二个为零。

laws.en: Across two tiers, lower members passing on what they take from their own stores and upper members giving the stores within supplied capacities, a consumer drawing past the stock needs a formation's giving into the hierarchy exactly where, at some step, the other upper members cannot give what the stores rise or the others cannot give the demand through the hierarchy. Witness Routing.
laws.zh: 跨两层，下层成员传递取自自身库存者、上层成员在所给容量内给予诸库存：消耗者汲取超出存量时，恰在某步其余上层成员给不出诸库存的上升、或其余者经由层级给不出需求之处，需要某构成向层级的给予。见证 Routing。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. Standpoints and formations as types, each standpoint's center given as a function; the relation a self is drawn along supplied, its base instances feeding and being affected; possible courses a supplied predicate on markings of the formations that continue; the presupposition a hypothesis of the laws it appears in, and nothing more.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。立场与构成为类型，每个立场的中心由一个函数给出；画自我所沿的关系是给定的，其基底实例为供养与受影响；可能的进程是对“哪些构成延续”之标记的给定谓词；预设只作为出现它的规律的假设。

hypotheses.en: On the base: flows with their webs that balance and in which only active formations give; the class of possible feeders of a family supplied, and that each can feed it alone (PartAlone) supplied; a consumer drawing past the stock across a stretch longer than the stock.
hypotheses.zh: 在基底上：平衡且只有活跃构成给予的流及其依存网；某条件族可能的供给者之类是给定的，每个能否单独供给（PartAlone）也是给定的；消耗者在长于存量的一段步上汲取超出存量。

hypotheses.en: For the flows read off a web: the web fixed, balance on the family within the stretch, only active formations giving, taking unrestricted; for the exact law, activity and identity of formations decided and the class a finite list.
hypotheses.zh: 就从依存网读出的流：依存网固定，在一段步之内对该族平衡，只有活跃构成给予，取用不受限制；就精确之律：构成的活动与同一可判定，类为有限列表。

hypotheses.en: For capacities: capacities supplied with the web, per formation and step over the whole family; each formation taking part once a step; the family listed without repetition and holding a named condition; for the shortfall law, activity and identity decided and the class listed.
hypotheses.zh: 就容量：容量随依存网给定，按构成与步、对整个族；每个构成每步只参与一次；该族列出而无重复且含一个指名的条件；就缺额之律，活动与同一可判定，类为有限列表。

hypotheses.en: For the exact law with capacities: the class listed without repetition, so that each member's capacity is counted once; activity and identity decided.
hypotheses.zh: 就有容量时的精确之律：类列出而无重复，使每个成员的容量只计一次；活动与同一可判定。

hypotheses.en: For stores: each member's store its own and outside the family, nothing feeding the stores, the stores not rising within the stretch. For a hierarchy: its families in order, each given only what is passed on from the one above.
hypotheses.zh: 就库存：每个成员的库存属其自身且在该族之外，无物供给库存，库存在这段步内不上升。就层级：其诸族有序，每族只得到从其上一族传来者。

hypotheses.en: For need in degree to be attained: the feeder a member able to give its shortfall at every step of the stretch.
hypotheses.zh: 就程度的达成：供给者是成员，且在这段步的每一步都能给出其缺额。

hypotheses.en: Every exact law on the base: the consumer outside the class and active across a stretch longer than the family's stock.
hypotheses.zh: 基底上的每条精确之律：消耗者在该类之外，并在长于该族存量的一段步内活跃。

hypotheses.en: For two tiers: the lower members' stores their own, outside the family and given only by upper members, whose capacities are supplied with the web; balance on the family and on every store within the stretch, the stores free to rise; the consumer in neither tier; the family and both tiers listed without repetition and apart.
hypotheses.zh: 对两层：下层成员的库存为各自所有、在该族之外、只由上层成员给予，上层的容量随依存网给定；该族与每个库存在区间内平衡，库存可以上升；消耗者不在任一层；该族与两层都无重复地列出且彼此分开。

does_not_show.en: The step of invariance where it is still needed: what lies beyond every center's closure, and each center counting from another's standpoint beyond its part as a condition.
does_not_show.zh: 不变之步仍被需要之处：位于每个中心闭包之外者，以及每个中心在作为条件之外、从他者立场算数。

does_not_show.en: That actual centers depend on one another, or that the alternatives to a condition they all need could not together give what each step demands: both are empirical.
does_not_show.zh: 实际的诸中心彼此依存，或它们都需要的某个条件的诸替代者合起来给不出每步的需求：二者都是经验问题。

does_not_show.en: That the self is drawn along feeding or need rather than a narrower relation: that reading is argued, and the de se question stays open outside the common closure.
does_not_show.zh: 自我沿供养或“所需”来画，而不是沿更窄的关系：这一读法是论证出来的；在共同闭包之外，从己问题仍未定。

does_not_show.en: What the class's continuation is owed when there are copies: the law says which members are reached, and no significance of a single formation states the class.
does_not_show.zh: 有多个副本时，类的延续应得什么：此律只说哪些成员被达到，单个构成的意义不陈述类。

does_not_show.en: That along being affected the shared scope carries the means-end warrant: what affects a continuation need not be needed by it.
does_not_show.zh: 沿受影响时共有的范围带有手段与目的之依据：影响一个延续者，未必为它所需。

does_not_show.en: Any order: scope fixes whose losses count; a result that ranks courses states the order its theorem takes, self-concern among them.
does_not_show.zh: 任何次序：范围只定谁的损失算数；排序之果陈述其定理所取之次序，自我关切亦在其中。

does_not_show.en: Which web an actual family has, which stores feed which formations, and which families form a hierarchy: the laws read capacities and bounds off a given web, and the arrangement of stores and tiers is supplied.
does_not_show.zh: 实际的条件族有怎样的依存网、哪些库存供给哪些构成、哪些族构成层级：这些规律从给定的依存网读出容量与界限，库存与层级的安排是给定的。

does_not_show.en: That a need holding where no flow lets the consumer draw past the stock is substantive: there it holds vacuously, and that is exactly where the class cannot give some step's demand.
does_not_show.zh: 在没有流使消耗者汲取超出存量之处成立的“所需”是实质的：那里它是空真的，而这恰是该类给不出某步需求之处。

detail.en: Copies: the user continues with the first copy alone on one possible course and with the second alone on the other, so it needs some copy and neither copy (Copies.two_copies).
detail.zh: Copies：在一条可能的进程上使用者只与第一个副本一同延续，在另一条上只与第二个，故它需要某个副本，而两个都不需要（Copies.two_copies）。

detail.en: Divided: two standpoints, each its own center along the empty relation; their closures differ, and the de se and de dicto readings part (Divided.selfAscribed_not_invariant).
detail.zh: Divided：沿空关系各自为中心的两个立场；其闭包不同，从己与从言两种读法分开（Divided.selfAscribed_not_invariant）。

detail.en: Feeders: one condition, the user taking a unit at every step, fed in one possible flow by the first copy alone and in another by the second alone; the user needs some feeder's giving and neither feeder's (Feeders.two_feeders).
detail.zh: Feeders：一个条件，使用者每步取一单位，在一个可能的流中只由第一个副本供给，在另一个中只由第二个供给；使用者需要某个供给者的给予，而两个都不需要（Feeders.two_feeders）。

detail.en: FeedersInTurn: one condition standing still, the first copy active at step 0 and the second at step 1; both steps call for giving, so the user, drawing past the stock across both, needs each copy's giving (FeedersInTurn.needs_both).
detail.zh: FeedersInTurn：一个静止的条件，第一个副本在第 0 步活跃，第二个在第 1 步；两步都需要给予，所以在两步上汲取超出存量的使用者需要每个副本的给予（FeedersInTurn.needs_both）。

detail.en: Capacities: one condition rising by one at every step, the user and two copies active throughout, so every step demands two units. With capacities one and two the user needs the second copy's giving and not the first's (Capacities.needs_second, Capacities.not_needs_first); with one each, neither can feed alone, both giving feed the condition, and the user needs both (Capacities.neither_alone, Capacities.jointly_feeds, Capacities.needs_both).
detail.zh: Capacities：一个每步上升一个单位的条件，使用者与两个副本始终活跃，所以每步需要两个单位。容量为一与二时，使用者需要第二个副本的给予而不需要第一个的（Capacities.needs_second、Capacities.not_needs_first）；各为一时，两者都不能单独供给，两者一起给予能供给该条件，使用者两者都需要（Capacities.neither_alone、Capacities.jointly_feeds、Capacities.needs_both）。

detail.en: SharedCopies: one condition rising by one at every step, the user and three copies active throughout, each copy able to give one unit, so every step demands two. No copy can feed alone (SharedCopies.none_alone), the user needs some copy's giving (SharedCopies.needs_some), and no copy's (SharedCopies.none_needed).
detail.zh: SharedCopies：一个每步上升一个单位的条件，使用者与三个副本始终活跃，每个副本能给一个单位，所以每步需要两个。没有副本能单独供给（SharedCopies.none_alone），使用者需要某个副本的给予（SharedCopies.needs_some），而不需要哪一个的（SharedCopies.none_needed）。

detail.en: OwnStores: two feeders on their own stores, the first holding three and falling by one a step, the second holding one; the user draws one a step. Once its store is empty the second gives nothing (OwnStores.second_spent), so the user needs the first feeder and not the second (OwnStores.needs_first, OwnStores.not_needs_second).
detail.zh: OwnStores：两个各依自己库存的供给者，第一个持有三、每步降一，第二个持有一；使用者每步汲取一。库存耗尽后第二个什么也给不出（OwnStores.second_spent），所以使用者需要第一个而不需要第二个（OwnStores.needs_first、OwnStores.not_needs_second）。

detail.en: TwoTiers: a user draws on a condition a feeder gives to, passing on what it takes from its supply, which a source gives to; both stand empty. The chain is possible (TwoTiers.possible), and the user needs the source's giving to the supply (TwoTiers.needs_source).
detail.zh: TwoTiers：使用者汲取某条件，一个供给者给予它并传出从自身供给处所取者，一个来源给予该供给处；两者都空着。这一链条是可能的（TwoTiers.possible），使用者需要来源对供给处的给予（TwoTiers.needs_source）。

detail.en: Capacities in degree: with copies of one unit and two against a demand of two, every flow in which the user draws past the stock has the second copy give at least one unit, some has it give exactly one, and the first copy's degree is zero (Capacities.second_in_degree).
detail.zh: Capacities 的程度：以一个单位与两个单位的副本对两个单位的需求，使用者汲取超出存量的每个流都使第二个副本至少给一个单位，某个流使它恰好给一个，第一个副本的程度为零（Capacities.second_in_degree）。

detail.en: FeedersInTurn.possible: the flow drawn across the two steps with the copy active at each giving lets the user draw past the stock, so the user's need of both copies (FeedersInTurn.needs_both) is not vacuous.
detail.zh: FeedersInTurn.possible：以每步活跃的副本给予而画过两步的流使使用者汲取超出存量，所以使用者对两个副本的需要（FeedersInTurn.needs_both）不是空真的。

detail.en: OwnStores in degree: every flow from the stores in which the user draws past the stock has the first feeder give at least two units, the units the second's empty store cannot give at steps 1 and 2, some has it give exactly two, and the second's degree is zero (OwnStores.first_in_degree).
detail.zh: OwnStores 的程度：使用者汲取超出存量的每个库存之流都使第一个供给者至少给两个单位，即第二个的空库存在第 1、2 步给不出的单位，某个流使它恰好给两个，第二个的程度为零（OwnStores.first_in_degree）。

detail.en: Routing: with every level at zero and one unit drawn a step, the user needs a lone upper member (Routing.top_needed) and a lone lower member that holds nothing, all the giving passing through it (Routing.lone_router_needed), but neither of two lower members (Routing.router_not_needed), and neither of two upper members (Routing.tops_not_needed) until a lower store rises by one, when each is (Routing.rise_needs_top); with one upper member and a store rising that only it can give, the user needs it though the lower stores' falls could feed the user (Routing.fill_needs_top).
detail.zh: Routing：各水平为零、每步汲取一个单位时，使用者需要唯一的上层成员（Routing.top_needed），也需要一无所持、一切给予都须经过的唯一下层成员（Routing.lone_router_needed），但两个下层成员中哪个都不需要（Routing.router_not_needed）；两个上层成员中哪个都不需要（Routing.tops_not_needed），直到某个下层库存上升一个单位，此时两者都被需要（Routing.rise_needs_top）；只有一个上层成员、某库存上升而只有它能给时，使用者需要它，虽然下层库存的下降本可供给使用者（Routing.fill_needs_top）。

next_delta.en: More tiers, each tier's capacity read off its own supply; the degree of need across two tiers. Need and feeding read with time are in need-and-feeding-read-with-time.
next_delta.zh: 更多层，每层的容量从其自身供给读出；跨两层的被需要程度。带着时间来读的所需与供养见 need-and-feeding-read-with-time。

correspondence.en: The ecological Self (Næss 1987): self-concern for a self drawn widely is care for all; here only the centers need depend on one another. The convergence hypothesis (Norton 1984, 1991) and its critics (Steverson 1995; Westra 1997): anthropocentric and nonanthropocentric policy converge within what humans need and part beyond it; here the de se and de dicto readings agree within the common closure. Transmission of reasons to necessary means (Kiesewetter 2015) against facilitative means (Raz 2005): need against feeding, parting where the others could together give what a feeder gives. Ecological redundancy (Walker 1992, 1995). Reading (the AI's, D64): human beings now plausibly lie within one another's feeding closures through one atmosphere, one biosphere and one economy.
correspondence.zh: 生态的大我（Næss 1987）：为画得足够宽的自我而有的自我关切即对一切的关切；此处只需诸中心彼此依存。趋同假说（Norton 1984、1991）及其批评（Steverson 1995；Westra 1997）：人类中心与非人类中心的政策在人所需者之内趋同、在其外分开；此处从己与从言两种读法在共同闭包之内一致。理由向必要手段传递（Kiesewetter 2015）与向促成手段传递（Raz 2005）：“所需”与供养，恰在副本处分开。生态冗余（Walker 1992、1995）。解读（AI 的，D64）：经由同一个大气、同一个生物圈与同一个经济，人类如今大概彼此位于对方的供养闭包之内。

detail.en: Reuses the own closure held de se and where the de se and de dicto readings agree (ownClosure_standpointInvariant_iff, selfAscribed_iff_withinSome) and what a standpoint's own presupposition forces (forced_iff_within).
detail.zh: 复用从己持有的自身闭包、从己与从言两种读法一致之处（ownClosure_standpointInvariant_iff、selfAscribed_iff_withinSome）以及立场自身的预设所迫使者（forced_iff_within）。

output.en: The de se readings agree where whatever lies within one center's closure lies within every center's; a presupposition at a closure forces exactly the closure.
output.zh: 凡在一个中心闭包之内者都在每个中心闭包之内处，从己读法一致；闭包处的预设恰迫使该闭包。

input.en: Centers within one another's closures; the closure under need.
input.zh: 彼此位于对方闭包之内的诸中心；“所需”之下的闭包。

detail.en: Reuses being affected and being fed from (Flow.AffectedBy, Flow.FedFrom) and their closures.
detail.zh: 复用受影响与受供养（Flow.AffectedBy、Flow.FedFrom）及其闭包。

output.en: The influence and feeding closures of a formation on a flow.
output.zh: 流上一个构成的影响闭包与供养闭包。

input.en: Centers sharing one condition within one another's closures.
input.zh: 共有一个条件、彼此位于对方闭包之内的诸中心。

conditions.en: The common condition depended on and exchanged with, or required and given to at one step.
conditions.zh: 共同条件被依存并被交换，或在某一步被需要并被给予。

detail.en: The whole-world case: on a mutually dependent or mutually fed flow, significance bounded by each center's closure is the continuation condition; here only the centers need depend on one another.
detail.zh: 整体的情形：在彼此依存或彼此供养的流上，以各中心闭包为界的意义即延续条件；此处只需诸中心彼此依存。

detail.en: The two scopes of the presupposition; here the narrow scope, held de se, is the wide one within the centers' common closure.
detail.zh: 预设的两种范围；此处在诸中心的共同闭包之内，从己持有的窄范围即宽范围。

detail.en: What lies beyond every center's closure, as Clearing's dweller does, is left to the step.
detail.zh: 位于每个中心闭包之外者（如 Clearing 中的居者）留给那一步。

detail.en: The same route's order: what self-concern alone ranks, given the scope fixed here.
detail.zh: 同一路线上的序：在此处所定的范围下，单凭自我关切排出什么。

history.en: 23 October 2026: added (IV3): the route through dependence, the relation a self is drawn along read as one its continuation is carried along; the de se and de dicto readings agree exactly where the centers lie within one another's closures; need and copies; after a literature check (significance review, dependence check); study section 373.

history.en: 23 October 2026: extended (IV3b): need stated for any courses with two readings, the marking case being the earlier need; need on the base over balanced flows fed only from a class, with the Feeders witness; study section 378.
history.zh: 2026年10月23日：扩展（IV3b）：“所需”对任意进程以两种读法陈述，先前的“所需”是标记的情形；基底上的“所需”，就只由某一类供给的平衡流而言，附 Feeders 见证；研究第 378 节。

history.en: 23 October 2026: extended (IV3c): the possible flows read off a fixed web; which feeders can feed a family alone derived from activity at the steps calling for giving, so the copies law holds over the web; the exact law of need; the FeedersInTurn witness; study section 382.
history.zh: 2026年10月23日：扩展（IV3c）：从固定的依存网读出可能的流；哪些供给者能单独供给某族由其在需要给予之步上的活动导出，所以副本之律在依存网上成立；“所需”的精确之律；FeedersInTurn 见证；研究第 382 节。

history.en: 23 October 2026: extended (IV3d): capacities of giving supplied with the web; a step's demand and the least flow; feeding alone exactly with capacities, and the copies law with them; need where the others could not together give the demand; the Capacities witnesses; the statement gained the capacity clause; study section 383.
history.zh: 2026年10月23日：扩展（IV3d）：随依存网给定的给予容量；某步的需求与最小流；有容量时单独供给的精确之律，及其下的副本之律；凡其余者合起来给不出需求之处的“所需”；Capacities 见证；陈述增加了容量一句；研究第 383 节。

history.en: 23 October 2026: extended (IV3e): the shares and the flow sharing the giving within capacities; need with capacities exact (a feeder needed exactly where the others could not together give the demand); the SharedCopies witness; the statement's capacity clause made exact and the converse removed from the boundaries; study section 384.
history.zh: 2026年10月23日：扩展（IV3e）：配对份额与在容量之内分担给予之流；有容量时的“所需”成为精确之律（供给者恰在其余者合起来给不出需求之处被需要）；SharedCopies 见证；陈述的容量一句改为精确，逆向从边界中移除；研究第 384 节。

history.en: 23 October 2026: extended (IV3f): what a feeder can give, read off its own supply (the supply bounds, capacities read off the feeders' own stores and the exact law with them); need up a hierarchy; the OwnStores and TwoTiers witnesses; the statement gained the hierarchy; study section 385.
history.zh: 2026年10月23日：扩展（IV3f）：从供给者自身的供给读出它能给多少（供给之界、从各自库存读出的容量及其下的精确之律）；“所需”沿层级上溯；OwnStores 与 TwoTiers 见证；陈述增加了层级；研究第 385 节。

history.en: 23 October 2026: extended (IV3g): need in degree (the shortfall; the least a feeder gives while the consumer draws past the stock, attained; need as a positive degree); the Capacities degree witness; study section 386.
history.zh: 2026年10月23日：扩展（IV3g）：按程度的“所需”（缺额；消耗者汲取超出存量时供给者至少要给的，并可达成；“所需”即程度为正）；Capacities 的程度见证；研究第 386 节。
